summary: The implementation correctly adds `startswith` and `endswith` methods to the Query class. Both methods only match string values (non-strings, None, and missing fields don't match), are case-sensitive, work with nested paths, support query combination and caching. All 234 tests pass including the 6 new tests for this feature.

checks.claim: startswith/endswith only match string values, non-strings don't match
checks.evidence: python -c test shows non-strings (5, None, missing field) are excluded from results

checks.claim: Methods work with nested paths and combined queries
checks.evidence: python -c test shows where('user')['name'].startswith('Al') works and combined queries work

checks.claim: Caching/hashing works correctly for identical queries
checks.evidence: python -c test shows same query parameters produce same hash and equality

findings.text: Empty string prefix/suffix matches all strings (standard Python behavior), which may be unexpected but is consistent with str.startswith/endswith
